profile.headline: Senior software Engineer
profile.summary: With several years of professional experience in information technology, I have a proven ability to support multiple projects with medium to high complexity. This includes managing the planning and implementation of SQL Java, application software, web applications, data warehouses, ETL pipelines, and relational database design. I am passionate about working with talented, hardworking individuals with diverse backgrounds and enjoy collaborating on a variety of projects. In addition to this, I believe that excellent communication is essential for both professional and personal development as well as the success of the company
